# F5 BIG-IP fixture provenance

Synthetic documents in the documented iControl REST shapes: virtual-server collection
(`items[].name/partition/destination/enabled/ipProtocol/pool`), internal data-group
(`name/partition/type/generation/records`), and `/mgmt/tm/sys/version` `entries` nesting.
Login uses the documented `/mgmt/shared/authn/login` token response (`token.token`,
`token.timeout`). No customer data. Live checks are operator-run acceptance.
